globalThis.comparison = (() => {
  const variant = Number(globalThis.variant || 0);
  const target = document.createElement('div');
  target.className = 'target';
  target.id = 'target';
  document.body.appendChild(target);
  const base = document.createElement('style');
  base.textContent = '.target{width:11px;height:5px}';
  document.head.appendChild(base);
  const cases = [
    ['bare', ':host{width:37px}', 11],
    ['functional', ':host(.target){width:37px}', 11],
    ['escaped', ':h\\6fst{width:37px}', 11],
    ['upper', ':HOST{width:37px}', 11],
    ['list', ':host,.target{width:37px}', 37],
    ['reverseList', '.target,:host{width:37px}', 37],
    ['functionalList', ':host(#target),.target{width:37px}', 37],
    ['negation', '.target:not(:host){width:37px}', 37],
    ['functionalNegation', '.target:not(:host(.target)){width:37px}', 37],
    ['doubleNegation', '.target:not(:not(:host)){width:37px}', 11],
    ['is', ':is(:host,.target){width:37px}', 37],
    ['isOnly', ':is(:host){width:37px}', 11],
    ['where', ':where(:host,.target){width:37px}', 11],
    ['whereImportant', ':where(:host,.target){width:37px!important}', 37],
    ['isNegation', '.target:is(:not(:host)){width:37px}', 37],
    ['notList', '.target:not(:host,.missing){width:37px}', 37],
    ['notMatchingList', '.target:not(:host,.target){width:37px}', 11],
    ['descendant', ':host .target{width:37px}', 11],
    ['child', ':host>.target{width:37px}', 11],
    ['sibling', ':host+.target{width:37px}', 11],
    ['following', ':host~.target{width:37px}', 11],
    ['has', '.target:has(:host){width:37px}', 11],
    ['hasNegation', '.target:not(:has(:host)){width:37px}', 37],
    ['specificity', ':is(:host(#other),.target){width:37px}.target{width:19px}', 37],
    ['whereSpecificity', ':where(:host(#other),.target){width:37px}.target{width:19px}', 19],
    ['media', '@media all{:host,.target{width:37px}}', 37],
    ['supports', '@supports (width:1px){:host,.target{width:37px}}', 37],
    ['layer', '@layer demo{:host,.target{width:37px!important}}', 37],
    ['rootList', ':root,:host{--measure:37px}.target{width:var(--measure)}', 37],
    ['attributeLiteral', '.target[data-value=":host"]{width:37px}', 37],
    ['attributeFalse', '.target[data-value=":root"]{width:37px}', 11],
    ['escapedClass', '.\\:host{width:37px}', 37],
  ];
  target.setAttribute('data-value', ':host');
  target.className = 'target :host';
  const result = {};
  for (const [name, source, expected] of cases) {
    const sheet = document.createElement('style');
    sheet.textContent = '/* variant '+variant+' */'+source;
    document.head.appendChild(sheet);
    result[name] = target.getBoundingClientRect().width === expected;
    sheet.remove();
  }
  result.recovery = target.getBoundingClientRect().width === 11;
  base.remove();
  target.remove();
  return result;
})();
